default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win22cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win22cis_rule_9_3_6 }}
registry:
  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsFirewall\PublicProfile\Logging\LogFilePath:
    title: "9.3.6 | Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Public: Logging: Name' is set to '%SystemRoot%\\System32\\logfiles\\firewall\\publicfw.log' | LogFilePath"
    exists: true
    value: '{{ .Vars.win22cis_public_firewall_log_path }}'
    type: REG_SZ
    meta:
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 9.3.6
      NIST800-53R5:
        - SC-7
        - SC-7(5)
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion: Imported from role task file `tasks/section_9/section_9.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS` and Audit control `section_9/section_9.x/cis_9.3.6.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

odvs.description: win22cis_public_firewall_log_path is the path to the public firewall log file. The control suggests %SystemRoot%\System32\logfiles\firewall\publicfw.log This is a variable to give some leeway on where to store these log files
odvs.name: public_firewall_log_path

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "9.3.6 | PATCH | Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Public: Logging: Name' is set to '%SystemRoot%/System32/logfiles/firewall/publicfw.log'"
  when: win22cis_rule_9_3_6
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_9.3.6
    - patch
    - firewall
    - public
    - NIST800-171_3.13.1
    - NIST800-171_3.13.5
    - NIST800-171_3.13.6
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-7
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-7_5
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsFirewall\PublicProfile\Logging
    name: LogFilePath
    data: '{{ win22cis_public_firewall_log_path }}'
    type: string
